Name: Fishing Pond Facilities
Author: tikamin557
Description:
He will open the facility to you if your friendship level with Willy increases.

Maybe you can introduce me to the special fishing pond in the basement when I get to know Willy better?

How do I get to the back of the basement?
Be very good friends with Willy and Wizard.
And if you hone your fishing skills to the highest level...!

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Features of each room, etc.[/size][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=4]Ground floor[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]All fish can be caught regardless of the season.
Fish-specific fishing times and fishing weather cannot be ignored.

[list]
[*][color=#ff0000][size=4]Underground[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]All fish can be caught regardless of the season.
Fish-specific fishing times and fishing weather are also ignored.
In other words, you can truly catch all fish at all times.

[list]
[*][color=#ff00ff][size=4]second floor[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]There is nothing special about it.
Please spend your time relaxing as a resting place.
(You can customize the 2nd floor in the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url]" settings.)
(Enabling "Clean Up" will allow you to place a bed and sleep in it.)

[list]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=4]Fishing spots to go from the underground warp.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]Different seasons warp to different places.
The fish are similar to the vanilla locations.
[color=#ffff00][size=4]The legendary fish appear only during the last week of that month, and the mini-games are slightly less difficult than in the vanilla fishing grounds.[/size][/color]
The default setting allows only one fish to be caught, just like vanilla.
It is also possible to set up "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url]" to allow the fish to catch the legendary fish as many times as they want in the last week of the year.[/spoiler]
[color=#00ff00][size=4]Facilities Unlocking Conditions.[/size][/color]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]The facilities themselves (ground floor and second floor)[/*]
[/list]Willy's friendship level is 4 or higher.

[list]
[*]Underground room[/*]
[/list]Willy's friendship level is 7 or higher.

[list]
[*]Wizard's warp room[/*]
[/list]Willy's friendship level is 9 or higher.
Wizard's friendship level is 9 or higher.
Fishing skill level 10.[/spoiler]
The outside view from inside the building also corresponds to the seasons.

You can enable each mod's fish to be caught at the facilities from the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url]" settings.
The default setting is "[color=#ffff00][size=3]false[/size][/color]".

[s]It also supports changes to the map of the town of "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/url]".
This should be enabled from mod config if used.[/s]
Currently SVR3 is not yet compatible with SDV1.6, so compatibility with SVR3 has been removed.
We will update to add compatibility when SVR3 is updated.

Compatible with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15100]Seven Deadly Sins[/url]" to edit town maps.
Compatible with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21740]Improve Town A Little[/url]" to edit town maps.
Compatible with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9052]Hypno Valley[/url]" to edit town maps.
(Slightly modify the location of the entrance to the "Hypno Valley" custom map, since the entrances to each map were in the same location.)


Some of the mod uses some of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22284]Magical Fishing Raft[/url] assets.
